name: C2-N Dominator Droid
description: The C2-N Dominator Droid was a battle droid used by the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War. In 3640 BBY the droid, along with TZ-3 Dominator Droid and DX-2 Dominator Droid was used to defend the approach to the Bastion in the Coronet City on Corellia, but was destroyed during the assault by the Galactic Republic forces.
